observations.observed: A single light bulb foreign body is visible in the left upper abdomen, showing a rounded glass envelope superiorly and a threaded metal base inferiorly, consistent with an intact incandescent bulb. Only one such object is present.

observations.expected: The visible ribs and upper abdominal anatomy are coherent.

Heart shadow is midline with normal contour. Hemidiaphragms are visible bilaterally. Lung markings branch and taper normally. Lumbar spine is midline and continuous. Bowel gas pattern in the lower abdomen appears connected and anatomically distributed. No duplicated organs or floating gas blobs are identified.
